notes: Each eval is a realistic docs-author request. Shared expectations encode the skill's hard rules; eval-specific ones check task fidelity. Visual quality (layout, no overlaps, light/dark, phone width) is judged in the browser on the dev server.
shared_expectations: Creates a data file under src/diagrams/flow/ that imports only from @site/src/components/FlowDiagram (plus react and @mdi/js)
The diagram file sets no colours, fonts, sizes or style props
At most 2 accent cards (3 in a long story) and at most 1 danger card
Results coming back (webhooks, replies, redirects) use the reply kind
No microservice (AutoPay, Wallet, ...) is drawn as its own lane or actor; the customer never calls an API
The page importing the diagram is .mdx

evals.name: webhook-story
evals.prompt: Add an interactive diagram to the webhooks overview page that shows how a payment webhook works: Ottu POSTs the signed result to the merchant's webhook_url, the merchant verifies the HMAC signature, answers 200, and Ottu retries if it doesn't. Readers should be able to click a step to read more.
evals.expected_output: A StoryDiagram with merchant and Ottu lanes (maybe gateway), detail text on each step, journeys for success and retry, signature verification visible, rendered on the webhooks page.
expectations: Uses StoryDiagram with journeys so the side panel shows

evals.name: sequence-3ds
evals.prompt: I need a sequence diagram for 3-D Secure on the Checkout SDK page: merchant creates a session, customer enters card in the SDK, Ottu asks the issuer for 3DS, the customer completes the challenge, Ottu charges and tells the merchant.
evals.expected_output: A SequenceDiagram with merchant, Ottu, customer and issuer/gateway actors, orange request arrows and blue reply arrows (both flowing by default), under 12 messages.
expectations: Customer only talks to the SDK/Ottu, never an API

evals.name: convert-autopay
evals.prompt: Replace the static AutoPay workflow diagram on docs/developers/payments/autopay/index.mdx with an interactive React Flow one like the card payment reference.
evals.expected_output: A StoryDiagram with customer, merchant and Ottu lanes (no AutoPay lane), first charge and every cycle journeys, replacing the old import on the page.
expectations: Old diagram import removed from the page
